fix: Keep two reusable scratch buffers in BackDispatcherState (e.g. `scratch_children: Vec<Rc<DispatcherCell>>`, `scratch_callbacks: Vec<Rc<dyn Fn() -> bool>>`). In dispatch_back: under the borrow, `let mut children = std::mem::take(&mut state.scratch_children); children.clear(); children.extend(state.children.iter().rev().filter_map(Weak::upgrade));` and the same for callbacks; release the borrow, run the callbacks, then `children.clear(); callbacks.clear();` and store them back into state under a fresh borrow. A nested dispatch finds empty scratch vectors and only allocates then, so steady-state back events do not allocate. Keep the retain() calls as they are.

Add `#[must_use = "dropping the subscription removes the back callback"]` above `pub struct BackCallbackSubscription`. The value returned by `BackButtonDispatcher::add_callback`, `ChildBackButtonDispatcher::add_callback` and `RootBackButtonDispatcher::add_callback` is the whole point of the call; discarding it unregisters the callback immediately.
